command:
Use the Write tool to create out/hello.txt containing exactly: hi
Then use the Read tool to read it back, and reply with one word: done.
scrubbing: the temporary home and config directories -> ~
the capturing user's home directory -> ~, and their login name -> user
every UUID (session ids, message ids) -> 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<n>, consistently
messaging_socket_path (a host path outside the workspace) -> '<host path>'
rate_limit_info: every utilization -> 0.5, every resetsAt -> 1790000000 (the account's usage isn't published)
events: written by hand from the native lines, following the mapping in contributing/runners.md, and reviewed
